meta.descricao: Federated futsal and athletics, judo, karate, dance, theatre and cycling — one club, many ways to belong.

pagina.titulo: There's a place for you at Valejas
pagina.intro: From the sports hall to the track, from the tatami to the stage. Federated competition, training for the youngest and activities open to the community.

academia.texto: Choir, chi kung, painting, computing, traditional dances, sueca and billiards. The club doesn't end when you stop competing.

cta.titulo: Fancy giving it a go? Talk to us and we'll bring you in.
cta.botao: Sign up or find out more

vagas.texto: Every sport has only a few places. Tell us what you're interested in and we'll let you know straight away if there's a spot — before you count on it.
vagas.curto: Limited places — talk to the club before you sign up

desporto.intro: From the sports hall to the track and the road. Some compete at federation level, others exist purely for youth development

cultura.intro: Activities to create, perform and get together, with no competition involved.

futsal.descricao: Valejas's biggest project. A professional team in the AF Lisboa district league, a B team right behind it, and a complete youth pathway from under-7s to under-19s — a kid can join the club as a child and reach the senior side without ever changing shirts.
futsal.publico: Men's senior teams and boys' youth teams

equipaA.descricao: Professional team, competing in the AF Lisboa district league.

equipaB.descricao: The step between the youth teams and the first team.

atletismo.descricao: Races and regular training, men and women, in every age group — from the youngest to seniors.
atletismo.publico: Men and women, all age groups

karate.descricao: A martial art with regular training and competition. Focus, posture and fitness — for complete beginners and for those who already compete.

cicloturismo.descricao: Rides around the region and group events. There's room for those who want to compete and for those who just want to ride in good company.

judo.descricao: Youth only, for the youngest, at the club's facilities. A partnership that brings to Valejas a children's judo school with years of experience.

parceria.descricao: One of the largest children's judo schools in the country, run by Renato Kobayashi and named after master Kiyoshi Kobayashi. Classes take place at the Valejas facilities.

danca.descricao: From rhythm to choreography, to let go, socialise and gain confidence.

teatro.descricao: Acting, rehearsing and performing. Group work, voice and presence — and an audience to see the result.
